description: Intercom provides customer support and customer communication software, including inbox, tickets, help center, reporting, and related workspace data. Its developer platform lets apps and AI tools access Intercom workspace data and actions.
summary: Intercom exposes a regional REST API at `api.intercom.io`/`api.eu.intercom.io`/`api.au.intercom.io` authenticated by bearer tokens (private app access tokens or OAuth tokens), plus authenticated remote MCP servers at `mcp.intercom.com/mcp` and `mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp` using self-onboarding OAuth.
